name: adapt-grow-accordion
summary: Accordion: a stack of header buttons that expand/collapse panels; single-open by default, optional multi-select and expand-first. Completes once every panel has been opened.

fill.note: The LESS reads --ab-* role tokens; grow-ab-bridge.less maps those roles onto the GROW scheme tokens (--accent, --ink, --line, --surface-2), so the component follows the theme hue and dark mode. Base --ab-* tokens come from adapt-ab-base; the semantic variant tokens (--ab-success/danger/warning/info) fall back to literals if a scheme does not define them.
